note: A derivation is a computation a consumer puts in place of a value, because the value is not known until the product runs: a wallpaper decides the accent, and the ink has to follow it. The system admits a derivation only when it can compute the floor that computation guarantees, and it reads the role at that floor rather than at a value. A floor under the minimum of a pairing the role is read in is not something the contract can accept — the consumer may still do it, and then it owes a deviation, not a value.

from-source.statement: The role takes its value from the product's own source — a wallpaper, a document, a frame — and the system does not know it in advance.
inputs: the source, read when the product runs
from-source.floor_basis: A ground carries nothing. The floor is the floor of the pairings it is read against, and those are checked on the inks, not here.

best-of-extremes.statement: The role takes whichever of the substrate's two inks measures higher against the ground it is written on.
inputs: the ground, unknown until the product runs
best-of-extremes.floor_basis: sqrt((L_shellWhite + 0.05) / (L_anthracite + 0.05)) with L_shellWhite = 0.8999 and L_anthracite = 0.0069. The worst ground is the one where the two inks read the same; there the reading is the geometric mean of the two extremes, 4.087:1. That clears a mark and it does not clear text — the system's own two inks are warm and near-black, not white and black, and the geometry of the choice is worth exactly 4.09.

best-of-extremes-clamped.statement: The ground is moved to the nearest tone at which the better of the substrate's two inks reaches the minimum the pairing requires, and the role takes that ink.
inputs: the ground, unknown until the product runs
best-of-extremes-clamped.floor_basis: The clamp is defined as the tone at which the reading reaches 4.5, so the reading reaches 4.5. The clamp is the consumer's operation, and the system cannot see it: the derivation is admitted only when the consumer names the deviation that carries the proof, and that deviation stays open while the proof is a test and not a measurement.
